title: Decide and, if approved, add automatic Software Factory worktree creation
summary: Tool-backed parallel dispatch gate passed end-to-end using declared isolated-copy scopes. The next maturation step is to decide whether to add automatic git worktree/branch creation around the existing lock manifest gate.

body.scope: Delivery-owned tooling/specification only; decide whether to automate git worktree/branch creation after a successful lock-manifest gate, before larger parallel builder scale-up.
hard_constraints: explicit owner approval required before execution
body.close_when: A decision is recorded: either hold worktree automation or implement a bounded helper that creates/removes named worktrees safely after lock-manifest validation, with expected-fail tests.

proposed_action: After owner approval, decide whether to add automatic git worktree/branch creation around the existing file-scope lock manifest gate.
requested_action: After owner approval, decide whether to add automatic git worktree/branch creation around the existing file-scope lock manifest gate.
success_signal: Software Factory has either a recorded hold decision or a validated helper for safe automatic worktree/branch creation after lock-manifest validation.
